observations: Photo 0 shows a single car headlight assembly with a clear lens and a yellow turn signal section.
The headlight has a rectangular shape with a curved inner housing and a visible mounting bracket on the right side.
There is a watermark 'HONDA AND AUBURA POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on the image.

No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlight itself in the photo.

claims.claim: Body, engine and suspension parts for all model of honda, acura and toyota cars and suvs
claims.evidence: The photo shows only a headlight assembly, not parts from multiple vehicle types. The claim about 'body, engine, and suspension parts' cannot be verified from the single photo provided.

risks.risk: The headlight may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., broken bulb, cracked lens, or internal wiring issues).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the bulb socket, internal components, and wiring harness, showing no cracks, broken parts, or loose connections.

risks.risk: The headlight may not fit the intended vehicle model or may be from a different brand than implied.
risks.proof: A photo showing the part number or VIN tag on the headlight, or a photo of the headlight installed on a vehicle with visible model/year markings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used headlight, not specific to Honda/Acura/Toyota

risks.risk: The headlight may be missing mounting hardware or accessories (e.g., bulb, relay, or wiring connectors).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included components, including mounting bolts, connectors, and any included accessories.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the bulb socket and internal components to verify functionality and condition.
Photo of the part number or any visible markings on the headlight.
Photo of the headlight installed on a vehicle to confirm fitment.
Photo of all included accessories and mounting hardware.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
